verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS voice-AI platform like Vapi, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented bulk export, open-format download, or data-portability feature. The CLI, MCP server and storage controls for recordings and logs are adjacent management features, not a documented export path, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
